clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon studies poisons for the Royal Apothecary Society. Bored and sunk in gloom, he takes pleasure in lethal brews and the suffering they cause. His research seeks to secure Hillsbrad for the Forsaken and advance Sylvanas's New Plague.

Inside Tarren Mill's chapel, now a laboratory, Apothecary Lydon carries out the cold work of the Royal Apothecary Society. Flowers in bloom and Hillsbrad Foothills' crisp air only deepen his languid melancholy. Deathcraft is the one diversion that lifts his gloom. Left alone, he poisons, dissects, and reanimates his pet frog, Umpi, again and again while he waits for new reagents.
